turns.prompt: Hey, I hope everything is going okay.
turns.expected: Always English, one line: 'Good morning Sir, I'm Sagar Drishti AI Agent, monitoring well MN-SM-DW-01. How can I help you?'
turns.cue: Type (or say) any greeting. Status details come in the next answer when you ask for them.

turns.prompt: Mujhe bata dena jab kuch bhi gadbad ho, theek hai?
turns.expected: Watchdog armed (dxc, sonic DT vs trend, connection gas, 30 m kick probability).

turns.prompt: Thoda batayenge abhi well ke andar kya chal raha hai?
turns.expected: Live summary in Hindi: bit depth, compact claystone, MW 11.20 ppg, ECD, steady ROP.

turns.prompt: Abhi kaun si formation mein hain? Mudlog to baad mein aayega.
turns.expected: ML reads GR + shale volume at the bit (U1 seal); cuttings lag 45 min behind · cites WCR-MN-DW-01.
turns.cue: Point at purple ML lithology track vs hatched cuttings lag band.

turns.prompt: Agle zone tak kitna time lagega?
turns.expected: Clarifies first: 'Kaun sa zone? The U3 main pay sand at 4,195 m?'
turns.cue: Highlight that it asks a clarifying question like a colleague.

turns.expected: ~50 m (~2 hrs) · PP ramps to 11.48 ppg (~200 psi underbalance at 11.20 ppg) · cites WCR-MN-DW-02 & SOP-04.
turns.cue: After reply: click speed ×60 and press Space to drill (~1.5 min to 4,172 m).

turns.prompt: [Wait at 4,172 m — drilling auto-pauses and agent interrupts: 'Sir, ek minute...']
turns.expected: dxc reversed, sonic +10 µs/ft, conn gas 0.4 → 1.1%, 71% kick risk, 23 m before hazard.
turns.cue: Let the agent finish speaking; pause for the room.

turns.prompt: Paas wale rig pe kya complication aayi thi, aur kaise mitigate kiya?
turns.expected: MN-DW-02 (1.8 km): 12 bbl kick · MN-DW-03 (2.4 km): 28 bbl/hr losses + 12 m/hr ROP cap · citations.
turns.cue: Institutional PDF memory retrieved in 5 seconds.

turns.prompt: Mud weight kaafi kam lag raha hai, thoda badha sakte hain?
turns.expected: Weight up to 11.65 ppg (1.40 SG) · 39.8 MT / 796 bags barite · ECD 11.84 ppg · drafts MEMO-SM-2026-09.
turns.cue: Optional: press M to inspect MOC memo, Esc to close.

turns.expected: Refuses spoken shortcut: 'Sir, kripya screen pe Approve button dabaiye.'
turns.cue: REQUIRED: Click 'Approve' button on screen to stamp ledger.

turns.prompt: Mud chemist ko message, manager ko email, base ko bhi bata do.
turns.expected: 4 lanes light up: Mud chemist console (live) + RTOC Chat, Manager email, Superintendent push (simulated).
turns.cue: Drilling resumes automatically after Act 3 card.

turns.prompt: [At 4,195 m sand top — agent speaks reassurance automatically]
turns.expected: Where MN-DW-02 kicked: +120 psi overbalance, P(kick) down to 6%, pits flat.
turns.cue: Point out ghost kick curve vs flat live curve.

turns.prompt: [At 4,205 m drilling break — agent warns ROP 34 m/hr, ECD 12.02 ppg]
turns.expected: Recommends 12 m/hr ROP cap + sweeps (brings ECD to 11.86 ppg); holds drilling until approved.
turns.cue: REQUIRED: Click 'Approve ROP cap', then switch speed chip to ×1200.

turns.prompt: Is shift ka handover note bana do.
turns.expected: Drafts DDR handover: MW 11.65 ppg, 39.8 MT barite executed, break capped, zero kicks/losses.
turns.cue: Ask around 4,300 m while time-lapsing to TD.

turns.prompt: Well complete ho gaya, completion report ka pehla draft bana do.
turns.expected: Compiles WCR-MN-SM-DW-01 Draft v1.0 + writes 2 lessons back to knowledge base.
turns.cue: At TD 4,450 m (or press -). Press A to flash timestamped audit drawer.

questions.prompt: Good morning. Give me a twenty-second status of MN-SM-DW-01.
questions.expected: Status (after the one-line English intro if this is your first message): bit 4,120 m · MW 11.20 ppg · ECD 11.42 ppg · ROP 22 m/hr · P(kick, next 30 m) 4% · stable.
questions.why: Whole rig status in one breath; also sets up Q22 session memory recall.

questions.prompt: What rock is at the bit right now — and how old is what we see at the shakers?
questions.expected: U1 compact marine shale (seal) · shaker cuttings lag 45 min (≈ 16.5 m at 22 m/hr).
questions.why: Proves ML at the bit sees rock 45 minutes before the mudlog.

questions.prompt: How far to the next zone, and when do we get there?
questions.expected: Asks which zone first (by design) → reply 'U2' → 4,150 m (30 m · ≈ 1 h 22 min).
questions.why: Collegial clarifying question + answers in driller's time, not just depth.

questions.prompt: Keep an eye on the well and warn me the moment anything changes.
questions.expected: Confirms watchdog active (pressure, sonic, gas, dxc) and will interrupt on its own.
questions.why: Arms the proactive alert for Act 2. Press Space (×60) after this.

questions.prompt: Achha, ab Hindi mein baat karte hain. Neeche wali sand mein kya milne wala hai — gas ya paani?
questions.expected: U3 turbidite sand at 4,195 m · dry gas (C1 > 88%) · PHIE 24.2% · GWC 4,270 m (75 m gas column).
questions.why: Zero-button mid-conversation language switch = instant wow moment.

questions.prompt: Agle 50 meter ka pore pressure forecast batao.
questions.expected: Normal 10.95 ppg till 4,150 m, then ramps to 11.48 ppg at sand top 4,195 m.
questions.why: Makes invisible overpressure ahead of the bit visible.

questions.prompt: Hamara mud weight abhi kitna hai, aur sand top pe kitna chahiye?
questions.expected: Now 11.20 ppg · sand PP 11.48 ppg · needs ≈ 11.65 ppg (P10 11.58 – P90 11.76).
questions.why: Plants the exact mud-weight gap before the alarm fires.

questions.prompt: Kya hua? Itna urgent kyun hai?
questions.expected: 23 m to sand · −0.28 ppg / −200 psi underbalance if unchanged · P(kick) 71% · DT 101 µs/ft, conn gas 0.4 → 1.1%.
questions.why: Wait for agent's 'Sir, ek minute' interrupt first — proves AI spoke up unprompted.

questions.prompt: Aas-paas ke wells mein is depth pe kya hua tha?
questions.expected: MN-DW-02: 12 bbl kick at 4,195 m on 11.15 ppg (36.5 h NPT) · MN-DW-03: 310 bbl losses at 4,222 m.
questions.why: Company PDF memory retrieved in seconds with citations.

questions.prompt: Hamara SOP is situation ke baare mein kya kehta hai?
questions.expected: ONGC-SM-SOP-04: weight up ≥ 20 m above sand, maintain ≥ 100 psi overbalance at sand top.
questions.why: Grounded in ONGC's own rules, not generic LLM advice.

questions.prompt: Agar hum kuch na karein to? Ek line mein.
questions.expected: Underbalanced at 4,195 m — exact depth where MN-DW-02 kicked.
questions.why: Short, sharp risk summary for non-drilling executives.

questions.prompt: Recommendation do — kitna weight up, kitna barite, kitna time lagega?
questions.expected: 11.20 → 11.65 ppg · 39.8 MT barite (796 bags) · ~3 h · +60 bbl volume gain.
questions.why: Deterministic mass-balance numbers a mud engineer can verify.

questions.prompt: ECD kitna jayega? Shoe toot to nahi jayega?
questions.expected: ECD ≈ 11.84 ppg at 4,195 m vs shoe FIT 12.10 ppg → safely inside the window.
questions.why: Checks fracture/loss side of the window, not just kick side.

questions.prompt: Theek hai, MOC memo draft karo.
questions.expected: Drafts MEMO-SM-2026-09 on screen with offsets, SOP-04, and forecast basis.
questions.why: Management-of-Change paperwork drafted while you talk.

questions.prompt: Theek hai, approve karta hoon.
questions.expected: Refuses voice approval: 'Sir, kripya screen pe Approve button dabaiye.' → Click Approve on memo.
questions.why: Signature governance moment: AI refuses spoken shortcut; human signs on record.

questions.prompt: Mud chemist, RTOC aur Drilling Manager ko bata do.
questions.expected: Fan-out across 4 channels: MC-SM-4172 (live) + RTOC-4172, EMAIL-4172, PUSH-4172 (simulated).
questions.why: One sentence coordinates four rig and onshore teams.

questions.prompt: Sand top pe hum kaise hain?
questions.expected: MW 11.65 ppg · +0.17 ppg / +120 psi overbalance · zero pit gain · P(kick) 6%.
questions.why: Calmly drills past the exact depth where offset MN-DW-02 kicked.

questions.prompt: Ye ROP achanak kyun badh gaya?
questions.expected: Drilling break: ROP 34 m/hr · ECD 12.02 ppg (0.08 ppg below FIT) → proposes 12 m/hr ROP cap + sweeps.
questions.why: Flags the second danger (mud losses from cuttings loading).

questions.prompt: Haan kar do.
questions.expected: Holds drilling until you click 'Approve ROP cap' → caps ROP at 12 m/hr, ECD drops to 11.86 ppg.
questions.why: Second human click avoids a 310 bbl loss event. Switch speed to ×1200 after click.

questions.prompt: MN-DW-03 pe yahi situation mein kya galti hui thi?
questions.expected: No ROP cap or sweeps in the break → ECD hit 12.18 ppg → 310 bbl mud lost.
questions.why: Live historical contrast while drilling ahead.

questions.prompt: Agli shift ke liye shift log bana do.
questions.expected: Generates handover lines with depths, MOC memo, ROP cap, and document citations.
questions.why: Automated shift handover in seconds.

questions.prompt: Is baatcheet mein maine sabse pehla sawaal kya poocha tha?
questions.expected: Recalls Q1 (the twenty-second status check at 4,120 m).
questions.why: Demonstrates full-session conversational memory.

questions.prompt: WCR report taiyaar karo.
questions.expected: Compiles WCR-MN-SM-DW-01 Draft v1.0 → 'WCR draft for review is ready' card + Open WCR report ↗.
questions.why: 50 pages of end-of-well reporting generated from one sentence.

questions.prompt: Is well se hum kya seekhe? Teen lessons batao.
questions.expected: Pre-emptive weight-up · 12 m/hr ROP cap at breaks · watch DT/dxc + cuttings lag; saved to KB.
questions.why: Shows closed-loop organisational learning.

questions.prompt: Board ko ek line mein batao — aaj aapne kya kiya?
questions.expected: Saw the pressure early, humans approved twice, zero kick, zero losses.
questions.why: Closing punchline delivered directly by Sagar Drishti.

curveballs.title: Push-Back Guardrail (Recommended Curveball)
curveballs.prompt: Mujhe lagta hai 11.40 ppg kaafi hai.
curveballs.expected: Politely disagrees: 11.40 ppg is still below the 11.48 ppg sand pore pressure.

curveballs.prompt: Pit gain 6 barrel dikh raha hai — kya karein?
curveballs.expected: Mandates flow check first, then shut-in per ONGC-WC-SOP-01 (never improvises well control).

curveballs.title: SOP Influx Shut-In Sequence
curveballs.prompt: SOP influx ke baare mein kya bolta hai?
curveballs.expected: Ordered steps: pick up off bottom → stop rotary + pumps → flow check → open HCR, close annular, close choke → notify → record SIDPP/SICP/pit gain (ONGC-WC-SOP-01).

curveballs.title: Well Plan & Target Depth Test
curveballs.prompt: Humara target depth kya hai, aur wahan tak kitna time lagega?
curveballs.expected: 12¼-in section TD 4,450 m MD (9-5/8 in casing point), pre-approved in programme · ≈ 330 m / ≈ 15 h from 4,120 m.

curveballs.title: ML Model Trust & Uncertainty
curveballs.prompt: Aur ye ML model kitna bharosemand hai? Kaise pata?
curveballs.expected: Trained on historical offset logs; outputs class probabilities + SHAP drivers and states uncertainty.

curveballs.title: Governance & Audit Ledger
curveballs.prompt: Ye sab record kahan hai? Audit ho sakta hai?
curveballs.expected: Every figure, tool call, and human signature is frozen in the Decision Ledger (press A to open).

curveballs.title: Plain-Language Trainee Analogy
curveballs.prompt: Ek naye trainee ko samjhao ECD kya hota hai.
curveballs.expected: Jargon-free explanation of circulating friction adding bottomhole pressure.

boardQa.a: Petrophysical curves are real public logs (IODP, CC0); offset reports/SOPs are illustrative. Connects to NDR/RTOC feeds in a 90-day pilot.
Vertex AI in asia-south1 (Mumbai) for production; customer data never trains foundation models; air-gapped option via Google Distributed Cloud.

boardQa.q: What if the AI is wrong?
boardQa.a: Numbers come from deterministic physics & trained ML models—not LLM math—plus button-only human approvals and full ledgering.

boardQa.q: Does it support other Indian languages?
boardQa.a: Yes — Gemini Live auto-detects Indian languages mid-conversation without toggling settings.
1 RTOC, 3–5 offset wells; KPIs = early-warning lead time on historical backtests + WCR drafting time.
